name: Jac
caption: Not to be dramatic but the black sheep might be the only ones awake. 🐑

slides.text:
This might sound crazy,

but being called “too much” or “weird” by the herd is usually the first sign you're thinking for yourself.

If you ever feel guilty for not wanting the life everyone told you to want,

remember this:

You're not ungrateful. You're awake.

And that's something worth holding on to.

We were taught to trade 40 years of our time for a few weekends of freedom.

Then we called it “normal.”

The black sheep just asked: why?
